name: Depeche Mode

whyMatters.en: Basildon synth group formed in 1980. Violator (1990) put sequenced bass and programmed percussion on US rock radio at arena scale.
whyMatters.zh: 巴西尔登合成器组合，1980 年成立。《Violator》（1990）把音序低音与程序打击乐推上美国摇滚电台，达到体育场体量。

lyricQuotes: Your own personal Jesus / Someone to hear your prayers
All I ever wanted / All I ever needed / Is here in my arms

shortBio.en: Gahan / Gore synth-rock, 1980–. Enjoy the Silence and Violator are the arena-scale peak.
shortBio.zh: Gahan / Gore 的 synth-rock，1980 年至今。《Enjoy the Silence》与《Violator》是体育场级高峰。

body.en:
Depeche Mode formed in Basildon in 1980. Early Mute singles with Vince Clarke and Black Celebration built a darker synth vocabulary. Music for the Masses and the 1988 Pasadena Rose Bowl show established live scale.

Violator (1990)—Personal Jesus, Enjoy the Silence—crossed into US rock radio. Sequenced bass and LinnDrum-style percussion carry arena dynamics without a conventional guitar-band lineup. Alan Wilder deepened programming and arrangement from 1982 to 1995; Fletcher held keys until 2022.
body.zh:
Depeche Mode 于 1980 年在巴西尔登成立。与 Vince Clarke 合作的早期 Mute 单曲及《Black Celebration》建立更暗的合成器语汇。《Music for the Masses》与 1988 年帕萨迪纳玫瑰碗演出确立现场体量。

《Violator》（1990）——《Personal Jesus》、《Enjoy the Silence》——打进美国摇滚电台。音序低音与 LinnDrum 式打击乐撑住体育场动态，无需传统吉他乐队编制。Alan Wilder 在 1982–1995 年加深编程与编曲；Fletcher 守键盘席至 2022。

note.en: Early Mute synth-pop; Clarke-era bounce before the darker turn.
note.zh: 早期 Mute synth-pop；Clarke 时期弹跳感，尚未转暗。

note.en: Violator peak; Gore guitar hook over Wilder-programmed rhythm.
note.zh: 《Violator》高峰；Gore 吉他 hook 叠 Wilder 编程节奏。

note.en: Music for the Masses tour; Rose Bowl-scale live synth-rock.
note.zh: 《Music for the Masses》巡演；玫瑰碗体量的现场 synth-rock。

body.en:
Depeche Mode move from Vince Clarke bounce to Gore’s minor-key songwriting. Black Celebration and Music for the Masses darken the palette; Violator (1990) hits US rock radio.

Enjoy the Silence pairs Gore’s guitar riff with programmed drums—a rock hook built from sequencers.
body.zh:
Depeche Mode 从 Vince Clarke 弹跳感转向 Gore 小调写作。《Black Celebration》与《Music for the Masses》压暗调色板；《Violator》（1990）打进美国摇滚电台。

《Enjoy the Silence》把 Gore 吉他 riff 与程序鼓配对——用音序器搭出的 rock hook。

title.zh: Wilder 制作与 Fletcher 键盘

body.en:
Gahan is the live voice; Gore writes most songs. Alan Wilder (1982–95) deepens drum programming and arrangement—peak on Violator and Songs of Faith and Devotion.

Fletcher held the keyboard chair until 2022; Wilder’s exit marks the post-1995 production shift.
body.zh:
Gahan 是现场人声；Gore 写大部分歌。Alan Wilder（1982–95）加厚鼓编程与编曲——《Violator》与《Songs of Faith and Devotion》为峰。

Fletcher 守键盘席至 2022；Wilder 离队标记 1995 后制作转向。

title.zh: 1990–2000 年代摇滚里的电子歌曲写作

body.en:
New Order and The Cure share the post-punk synth lineage; Muse and Radiohead cite DM’s dark melodic side. Coldplay’s early piano-rock ballads sit near Enjoy the Silence’s chord mood.

Sequencers carry arena dynamics that many listeners associate with guitar bands.
body.zh:
New Order 与 The Cure 共享 post-punk 合成器谱系；Muse 与 Radiohead 引用 DM 暗色旋律面。Coldplay 早期钢琴摇滚谣曲接近《Enjoy the Silence》的和弦情绪。

音序器也能撑住许多听众联想吉他乐队的体育场动态。
